name: Frontiers of the Roman Empire
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, Germany
description: This site preserves stretches of the northern edge of the Roman Empire at its greatest extent in the 2nd century AD. It includes Hadrian's Wall in northern England, a 118-km barrier begun around AD 122, and Scotland's shorter Antonine Wall. In Germany, two sections run 550 km toward the Danube. Walkers can trace ditches, forts and watchtower remains across the landscape.
